leadText:
Monica (Japanese: モニカ Monica) is a character of the day who appeared in Hungry for the Good Life!. She is the housekeeper of Mr. Backlot's and Trophy Garden estate.

Monica first encountered and while she was in the process of catching a that escaped Mr. Backlot's mansion. Afterwards, she took them back to the mansion to get out of a storm and meet Mr. Backlot. They also met all of the Pokémon that Monica cares for. She makes Poffins for them to eat.

After nabbed the group and Mr. Backlot's Pokémon, Monica drove them directly to the Rocket trio's location. After defeated Team Rocket, Monica informed her of an upcoming in Celestic Town.
